feature: GPUI window embedding WKWebView per tab
acceptance: A Mac opens a Relay window; pages render and scroll natively inside the GPUI layout; resizing keeps the web view aligned

feature: Vertical tab bar with agent tab group tint
acceptance: Tabs list in a left sidebar in hub order; agent-owned tabs are visibly tinted and grouped; clicking activates

feature: Cmd+K palette for URLs / tabs / history / commands
acceptance: Cmd+K opens a fuzzy palette; Enter on a URL or search loads it; tabs and history are ranked; all keyboard

feature: Cmd+T / Cmd+W / Cmd+L / Cmd+1-9 shortcuts
acceptance: Each shortcut works from anywhere in the window; covered by a keymap unit test

feature: WKContentRuleList ad and tracker blocking
acceptance: EasyList subset compiles to WebKit JSON (tested); on a Mac the built-in list blocks doubleclick.net before load

feature: Injected bridge streams DOM / network / console
acceptance: bridge.js in WebKit emits snapshots / patches / console / fetch+XHR and every message parses in Rust

feature: Bridge actions: highlight / editStyle / click / type
acceptance: Commands run in a real WebKit page and fire the page's own listeners; missing ids report an error

feature: Native Inspector pane: Elements / Network / Console / Cookies
acceptance: A split pane renders the live hub state for the active tab and updates as the page changes; hovering an element highlights it

feature: MCP server exposing tabs and bridge state to agents
acceptance: A real MCP client lists tools and drives open_tab / read_dom / wait_for / get_page_info / type_text / click_element / get_console_logs / get_network_requests

feature: relay mcp stdio proxy for Claude Code / OpenCode / Codex
acceptance: claude mcp add relay -- relay mcp connects to the running browser socket (user-only 0600) and tools work end to end on a Mac

feature: Agent-safe attached mode pauses on CAPTCHA / 2FA
acceptance: Agent clicks fail with waiting-for-human on any tab showing a challenge (user tabs included); reads continue; agents cannot close user tabs; slept tabs wake for agents

feature: Chrome import: bookmarks / history / extension list
acceptance: Fixture profile imports bookmarks with folders / history newest-first / localized extension names; idempotent store import

feature: Chrome password CSV into macOS Keychain
acceptance: CSV parses with redacted Debug (tested); on a Mac imported logins appear in Keychain Access as internet passwords

acceptance: CRX3 header id checked and zip unpacked without traversal (tested); on a Mac uBlock Origin Lite installs by id and runs

feature: Automatic tab sleeping with snapshot restore

feature: Multi-pane split view

feature: Vimium-style link hints
